To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) there are significant national and international spillover effects from R&D, (2) these spillovers are stronger in R&D intensive industries, (3) there is no evidence of spillover effects between industries, (4) FDIs seem to increase spillovers from domestic R&D, and (5) the effect on growth of R&D embodied in intermediates is negligible.
